alternatives_rejected.why: Its own span self-time is flat (0.2->0.2ms). The inbound slowdown comes only from checkoutservice calls, which are also slow to 5 other callees (E3). Its large latency z-score (E1, E2) is caller-observed, not its own processing.
It is one of 6 checkoutservice callees that slowed at the same time (E4). A uniform slowdown across every outbound call points to the caller's network, not an independent shippingservice fault.
Its latency deviation (E1) is also one of checkoutservice's 6 slowed outbound paths (E4), so it is a symptom, not a source.

proposed_fix.description: Find and remove the injected network delay on the checkoutservice pod's interface (e.g., inspect `tc qdisc show` and delete the netem rule). Then confirm checkoutservice self-time p50 returns to about 4ms and callee latencies recover. Only if no rule is found, do a rolling restart of the checkoutservice pod.
